newsitem.title: LEBANON: Gunman fires at Japanese tour bus in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Gunman fires at Japanese tour bus in Lebanon.

text.p: An unidentified car driver fired on Tuesday at a bus carrying Japanese tourists in Lebanon after a right-of-way dispute with the bus driver, police said.
The gunman fired a single pistol shot at the bus before driving off, they said.
No one was hurt in the incident near Baalbek, 90 km (55 miles) east of Beirut, whose Roman temples are Lebanon's biggest tourist attraction.
The bus was bringing the tourists from Damascus, the Syrian capital, when the shooting occurred. The Japanese later inspected the ruins without further incident.
Police said they were trying to track down the gunman.
